images.name: install
images.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset: a small spot illustration for a Korean engineering manual, 45 mm wide when printed. Create one original retro Japanese PC-98 / early 1990s computer-game pixel-art office vignette. Adult junior security analyst with short dark hair, navy blue work jacket, cream shirt, neutral attentive face visible in front three-quarter view, seated at a small beige desktop computer and typing installation commands. Monitor screen faces the analyst; viewer sees its opaque back, physically correct perspective. One desk, keyboard, tower computer and one small disk case. Crisp deliberate square pixels, limited indigo, dusty lavender, muted cyan and soft rose palette, stippled checkerboard dithering, clear dark outlines, warm off-white highlights. Same modest realistic adult proportions throughout the book, not chibi. Compact single scene, generous transparent margin on all sides, no room background. No letters, no UI text, no speech balloon, no logos, no headset. Not smooth vector art, not photorealistic, not 3D render. Transparent background.
